notes: Raptors (Jurassic Park: InGen vs Raptors). Three Raptors (Blue the hero fighter, Delta and Echo flagged hero in the HeroDef), 7 life and move 3 each; every card is ANY. Written from the card images on 2026-11-13.

ability.text: Raptors add 1 to the value of their attack cards for each of your other Raptors adjacent to the defender.
ability.notes: The pack bonus is the HeroDef passive `{effect: pack_bonus, n: 1}` (data/heroes/raptors.json), read by sparring/pack.py through Game.attack_bonus_parts / Game.attack_bonus: +n to every attack card (an attack, or a versatile card played as an attack) of a Raptor for each OTHER undefeated Raptor of its owner standing next to the defender. Defense cards get nothing ('their attack cards').

cards.title: Ambush
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: Your opponent discards 1 random card. Add its BOOST value to this card's value.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / boost 3. Plugin `blue:ambush`: the opponent discards a card by chance and its BOOST is added to this card's value (a card with no BOOST adds 0; an empty hand adds nothing; Counterhex Shield forbids the discard). Against a human the bot says a position from 1 to the number of cards in their hand, they discard the card standing there on their discard pile and press Done, and the bot reads which card it was (Ivan, 2026-11-13). Cancelling the card's effects (Feint) cancels the bonus.

cards.title: Clever Girl
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If one or more of your Raptors is adjacent to the opposing fighter, gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Attack 3 / boost 3. Read when the AFTER resolves, win or lose: the Raptor that played the card counts when it is next to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Coordinated Attack Pattern
cards.text: Choose one of your Raptors. You may place each of your other Raptors in any space in the chosen Raptor's zone.
cards.notes: Scheme (boost 2). ONE question: the owner chooses one undefeated Raptor (`for_each` over a single fighter, `pick: one`); the others that still stand are then each placed on an empty space of its zone (the space may be the one a Raptor already stands on when it is in that zone). The chosen Raptor never moves.

cards.title: Decoy
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Choose one of your other undefeated Raptors. You may place her adjacent to the opposing fighter.
cards.notes: Defense 3 / boost 1. 'Other' is any undefeated Raptor but the one that plays the card; the placement is optional and goes to an empty space next to the opposing fighter (with none free nothing happens). It happens before the DURING, so the new position counts for the rival's pack bonus only if the card is played by a Raptor's rival (the bonus is read at the reveal of the values).

cards.title: Disengage
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Move your Raptor to any other space in her zone.
cards.notes: Attack 4 / boost 2, any Raptor. Happens whether the combat was won or not; 'your Raptor' is the fighter that played the card (a defeated one is not placed). The space must be a different one of her zone (`other`), and with no other empty space in it nothing happens (the same reading as Bigfoot's Disengage, Iván 2026-11-03).

cards.title: Eaten Alive
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to one adjacent opposing fighter.
cards.notes: Versatile 4 / boost 2. Effect damage to ONE opposing fighter next to the Raptor that played the card, chosen by its owner (the combat's opponent when it is adjacent counts). A won defense counts as winning the combat (the global tie rule applies).

cards.title: Feint
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Pack Hunters
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter for each of your Raptors adjacent to them.
cards.notes: Attack 4 / boost 2. Effect damage; the count is read when the AFTER resolves and includes the attacking Raptor itself when it stands next to the defender (it is one of 'your Raptors adjacent to them'). A defeated Raptor is not counted.

cards.title: They Remember
cards.notes: Attack 2 / boost 2. The action is gained whether the combat was won or not.

cards.title: Working Things Out
cards.text: Move each of your Raptors up to 3 spaces. You may move them through spaces containing opposing fighters. Gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Scheme (boost 2). Every undefeated Raptor moves up to 3 spaces (0 included), through opposing fighters but not to a space they hold; the owner chooses the order (the same op as Eredin's Close For The Kill). The action is gained once, after the moves.

plugins.why: Ambush: the discard is by chance and, for the table player, the bot names a position and reads the card they lay on their pile; the BOOST of that card is added to the value. No op reads a card the table player discarded.

hidden_info.rule: Against the engine's player the discard is by chance and nobody looks; against the table player the bot names a position and reads only the discarded card.

open_questions: Loss rule: implemented as 'the owner loses when ALL three Raptors are defeated' (unmatched-memory and the card print one hero, RAPTORS, 7 life; the save has three Hero miniatures with a Hero Health dial each).
